about: What Protium can run today. 'steamplay discover' reads this to judge a game; change a status here when a wave of work lands. status: good, partial, missing or blocked. score: what the feature adds to a game's score when the game needs it.

d3d9.note: Direct3D 9 on Metal (mtld3d); Left 4 Dead runs

d3d11.note: Direct3D 11 on Metal (DXMT); IRON NEST, Just Die Already, GTFO, Call of Duty: WWII

d3d12.note: Direct3D 12 through vkd3d-proton on KosmicKrisp; IRON NEST runs, heavy titles are untested or slow to load

vulkan.note: Vulkan on KosmicKrisp; Red Dead Redemption 2 reaches gameplay

opengl.note: OpenGL stops at 2.1 (macOS's own); newer needs Zink, which is not built yet

dotnet.note: .NET Framework programs need wine-mono, which is not in the bundle yet

unreal5.note: Unreal Engine 5 wants shader model 6.6 and compiles very large shaders; untested here

x86_32.note: 32-bit games run through FEX's WoW64 side

launcher.note: Third-party launchers: Rockstar's works; others are untested and often need a fix each

embedded_browser.note: An embedded Chromium (libcef) draws from a second process, which needs a per-program fix

anticheat_files.note: no macOS runtime of it exists, so its protected (online) modes will not start

anticheat_kernel.note: Kernel-level anti-cheat cannot run under Wine

heavy.note: Valve found it slow on the Deck; here x86 code is translated by FEX, so CPU-heavy games lose more
